Title: Return to Saradoc
Text: I need to return to Saradoc in the Brandy Hall and report the attack on the Hay Gate.

pages:
Hello adventurer,
I want to thank you again in the name of the Hobbits of Buckland.

The attacks of the Hurons have slowed down and the farmers stopped complaining.

The new guards arrived at the Hay Gate and the survivor

retired. His actions and your help will never be forgotten.

Now we are prepared incase it will happen again.

Good luck on your future journey!

Your
Saradoc

CompleteText:
I have returned to Saradoc and should tell him about the attack on Hay Gate.
